items.q: Bessie Smith had come through there, vaudeville, and the blues singer, Bessie Smith, and they had practically broke up the band

ctx.x: The instrumentation then was Herbert Scott, Bessie Smith had come through there, vaudeville, and the blues singer, Bessie Smith, and they had practically broke up the band, so I got Herbert Scott as a trumpet player--
